facts.value: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Ltd. announced unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27 (quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026)
Q2 FY27 Revenue of Rs. 1,547 crores with 35% YoY growth
Q2 FY27 EBITDA of Rs. 356 crores with margin of 23.0%, 23% YoY growth
Q2 FY27 PAT of Rs. 223 crores with net profit margin of 14.4%, 29% YoY growth
H1 FY27 Revenue of Rs. 2,857 crores with 43% YoY growth
H1 FY27 EBITDA of Rs. 658 crores with EBITDA margin of 23.0%
H1 FY27 PAT of Rs. 403 crores with net profit margin of 14.1%, 36% YoY growth
BEV revenue grew 129% YoY, reaching 51% of Automotive revenues
New order additions of Rs 36bn, net order book at Rs 251bn (second highest ever)
Net order book of Rs. 25,100 crores with EV and Robotics & Physical AI programs contributing 65%
Global OEM of electric passenger vehicles awarded order for helical limited slip differentials for EV platform
Indian OEM of ICE and electric two-wheelers awarded order for integrated motor controllers
Indian OEM of ICE and electric two-wheelers awarded additional traction motor volumes under existing order
Indian OEM of passenger, commercial, off-highway and electric vehicles awarded order for differential assemblies (ICE)
North American OEM of passenger vehicles and EVs awarded order for starter motors
New customer OEM of ICE and electric two-wheelers awarded order for rear radar sensors
Sona Comstar's Driveline Division awarded the 2026 Deming Prize for Total Quality Management by JUSE

note.summary: Q2 FY27 revenue ₹1,547 crore (+35%); PAT ₹223 crore (+29%); net order book ₹25,100 crore.
